messages:
Aisha Bello: trying to lock alert thresholds for “stuck provisioning stage” before we turn on the dashboard + alerts. question: when do we page vs create a ticket? current draft is paging on any stage > 30m, which feels like instant noise.

Rafael Mendes: +1, 30m will page constantly in Imaging on some regions/SKUs. We need stage-aware thresholds + only page for prod customer pools.

Allison Grant: can we anchor off the stage timing budgets from the provision-to-ready doc? like: alert at 2x budget, page at 4x budget (or something). also need to handle “paused” runs so we don’t alert.

Sergio Costa: dashboard PR is up btw: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability-pack/pull/1204 (templates include pool_id, customer_id, region, sku). alerts are currently stubbed as:
- StuckStageWarning: stage_duration_seconds > 1800
- StuckStageCritical: stage_duration_seconds > 3600
happy to change.

Miles Thornton: stage budgets vary wildly. Provisioning/Terraform can be 10–40m depending on quota retries. Imaging can be 60–120m (and sometimes longer if artifact mirror is sad). Bootstrapping should be much tighter (10–20m). Validating/perf-canary ~10–15m.

Logan Wright: from historical logs, p95 per stage (rough):
- Provisioning: 35m
- Imaging: 95m
- Bootstrapping: 25m
- Validating: 18m
- Ready (control plane transition): <5m after validation
if we page at 30m we’re going to have a bad time.

Aisha Bello: ok so maybe:
- WARNING = stage > p95
- CRITICAL = stage > 2x p95
and then add routing rules to page only if env=prod AND pool_tier=dedicated AND customer_pool=true?

Rafael Mendes: I’d rather page based on impact + actionability:
- Page if (prod customer pool) AND (stuck in Bootstrapping/Validating/ReadyTransition) for > 45m (those are “should never happen”)
- Ticket if stuck in Provisioning/Imaging for > 2h (or > 3h?) since those can be vendor/infra slowness.

Allison Grant: agree. also we should separate “no progress” vs “just slow”. We have stage_start + stage_heartbeat events now, right?

Gabe Wilson: we emit stage_start + stage_finish + stage_failure. heartbeat is not implemented yet. “stuck” right now is basically: stage_start without stage_finish for X.

Allison Grant: ok then we need to be careful with false positives during retries. does the state machine reset stage_start on retry or keep the original?

Gabe Wilson: retry creates a new attempt_id but same stage name. metric labels include attempt_id; the alert can group by run_id + stage and use max(stage_age).

Sergio Costa: in PR-1204 I added labels: run_id, pool_id, stage, attempt_id, env. grouping can be changed in alertmanager. we can also add an annotation link to the run status endpoint.

Aisha Bello: what about paging thresholds by stage (proposal):
- Bootstrapping: page > 45m
- Validating: page > 45m
- ReadyTransition: page > 20m
- Provisioning: ticket > 90m, page > 3h if prod customer pool
- Imaging: ticket > 2h, page > 4h if prod customer pool
Does that match operator expectations?

Miles Thornton: I like it but imaging “ticket >2h” might still be noisy for new regions. maybe ticket at 3h? We had a couple 2h20m runs last month that resolved themselves.

Rafael Mendes: +1 bump ticket thresholds slightly for imaging, but keep paging high.

Logan Wright: data-wise, imaging p95 ~95m, p99 ~140m. ticket at 3h seems safe.

Allison Grant: also: don’t page if run has label pause=true or state=Paused. can we plumb that into alert labels?

Gabe Wilson: yes, we emit a run_state metric; we can add a matcher `run_state!="Paused"` in the alert expr.

Sergio Costa: ack. I’ll update the rules to include that. Also want to decide: do warnings create tickets automatically or just show on dashboard?

Aisha Bello: I’d prefer:
- Warning => create Jira INT ticket (not page)
- Critical => page (only for prod customer pool + actionable stages)
But this depends on whether we have auto-ticketing wired.

Rafael Mendes: auto-ticketing is ok if deduped by run_id; otherwise we’ll spam INT. Can Alertbot create one ticket per run_id + stage and update it?

Redwood Alertbot: FYI: Alertbot supports Jira create-or-comment via `dedupe_key` (e.g., `provisioning:${env}:${pool_id}:${run_id}:${stage}`) and can auto-assign based on labels.

Allison Grant: perfect. please add `dedupe_key` and route warnings to ticket-only. critical to pager.

Miles Thornton: also: page only for stages after infra is up. If we page on Provisioning being slow, half the time it’s quota + not actionable immediately.

Aisha Bello: summarizing decision (unless objections):
1) Alerts are stage-specific.
2) Ticket-only thresholds:
   - Provisioning stuck > 90m (ticket)
   - Imaging stuck > 180m (ticket)
3) Paging thresholds (prod + customer pool only, run_state!=Paused):
   - Bootstrapping stuck > 45m (page)
   - Validating stuck > 45m (page)
   - ReadyTransition stuck > 20m (page)
   - Provisioning stuck > 3h (page)
   - Imaging stuck > 4h (page)
4) Warning alerts always create/update a Jira INT ticket using dedupe_key; Critical uses Pager + also comments on the ticket.

Sergio Costa: works for me. I’ll push changes to PR-1204 tonight + add the alert annotations:
- link to dashboard panel (with pool_id/run_id prefilled)
- link to runbook section “stuck stage triage”

Rafael Mendes: please also add a note in the annotations: “check if retries are ongoing; look at attempt_id changes” + “if stage=Validating check perf-canary job status”.

Logan Wright: I’ll drop a snippet in the PR comments with metric names + sample PromQL for stage age. Also: should we include a burn-rate style alert (failure rate) or just stuck?

Aisha Bello: just stuck for this sprint; failure-rate is next iteration. let’s not boil ocean.

Allison Grant: +1. ship something safe + low-noise first.

Sergio Costa: cool, will update PR and tag @Aisha @Rafael for review.

Aisha Bello: thanks. once merged, we’ll enable in staging first and watch for a day before prod.
